subject: maths
question: Two stations A and B are 230 km apart on a straight line. One train starts from A at 4 a.m. and travels towards B at 40 km/hr. Another train starts from B at 5 a.m. and travels towards A at a speed of 55 km/hr. At what time will they meet?
solution:
**Given**

Distance = 230 km

**Formula used**

Relative speed = Distance/Time

Relative speed = S₁ + S₂ (when train travel opposite direction)

**Calculation**

Distance between station A and B is = 230 km

Speed of first train = 40 km/hr

Speed of second train = 55 km/hr

Relative speed both train if they running opposite direction = (40 + 55) = 95 km/hr

Distance covered by first train in 1 hr = 40 km

Remaining distance = 230 - 40 = 190 km

Time = Distance/speed

Time = 190/95 = 2 hr

∴ Required time = 5 am + 2 hr = 7 am

**The answer is 7 a.m.**
